Global Cement and Concrete Association (GCCA) (2026). Getting the Numbers Right (GNR 2.0) cement sustainability database: country extract for Canada, data years 1990-2024 (32 indicator workbooks incl. 8TG, 8TGK, 21TGWcm/ct/ce, 12AG, 19AGW, 92AGW, 92AGWce, 59cAG, 59cAGK, 71AG, 59cAGWce/ct, 71AGWce/ct, 25aAG, 25aAGK, 25aAGFC, 25aTGW, 93AGW, 33AGW, 33eAGW, 33cAGW, 108TGW, 115TGW). London: GCCA. Exported from the GNR online portal (filter country_name is Canada) and held by CIEEDAC at P:\CIEEDAC\Industry\Cement\2024\GCCA; file timestamps 2026-07-31.

Region is CANADA ONLY: every workbook carries the portal filter "country_name is Canada"; no World, North America or EU rows exist in the held files. Year: latest data year 2024 (folder label 2024; publication/export 2026). Main file: one GNR industry-average (benchmark) example per kiln class at its latest reported year - dry with preheater and precalciner 2024, dry with preheater without precalciner 2021, long dry 2018, wet/shaft 1990 (thermal energy per t clinker excluding fuel drying, 25aAGK; gross CO2 per t clinker, 59cAGK) - plus an all-kilns weighted average for 2024 (25aAG, 33eAGW power up to clinker, 59cAG) and a whole-cement-plant average (33AGW kWh/t cement, 59cAGWce kg CO2/t cement equivalent). Flows: 2024 clinker-to-cement ratio and MIC (gypsum, limestone, slag, fly ash, pozzolana, others) per t cement. Other-values: 2024 production, ratios, MIC shares, fuel-mix shares and derived GJ/t by fuel group, alternative-fuel mix, net CO2, CO2 per cementitious, external power, coverage (21 plants, 4 companies, 92%); time series 1990/2005/2010/2015/2020 for fleet thermal energy, CO2, power, clinker ratio, AF/biomass shares and kiln-class values. No semi-dry/semi-wet class in the Canadian data. Locator convention: copied workbook file name + GNR indicator code + data year (no pages). Heating value: not printed; GNR follows the CSI/GCCA CO2 and Energy Protocol, which uses net calorific values (LHV). Traps: (1) GCCA.xlsx is a compiled workbook whose Data-sheet 25aAGK rows are blank (formula failure) and whose 2025-2030 columns show #VALUE!; kiln values were read from the 25aAGK sheet / separate file, which agree. (2) The 25aAGK export was filtered to exclude 2006-2009 and 2011-2014. (3) 8TGK 2024 shows only precalciner kilns (5.25 of 10.74 Mt clinker); other kiln classes are missing after 2018/2021, presumably suppressed for confidentiality. (4) 25aAGF sheet: GJ for 1990-2022, shares for 2023-2024, Data sheet labels both GJ. (5) 92AGW unit label says % but values are fractions. (6) 33cAGW 2022 (165.09 kWh/t) exceeds total 33AGW (140.31), anomaly. (7) 12AG/19AGW are percent of cement (read as mass share).
